assignments.title: Spreadsheet Data Cleanup
assignments.overview: Clean and organize a small spreadsheet dataset using the formulas and functions from this module, then summarize your findings.
requirements: Remove duplicate rows and handle blank cells
Use at least one lookup formula (e.g. VLOOKUP) to enrich the data
Add a summary section with SUM/AVERAGE calculations
Share the finished spreadsheet or a public link to it

instructions.title: Review the data
instructions.description: Open the provided sample dataset and identify duplicate rows, blank cells, and inconsistent formatting.

instructions.title: Clean it up
instructions.description: Remove duplicates, fill or flag missing values, and standardize formatting.

instructions.title: Summarize
instructions.description: Add a summary section using SUM/AVERAGE and at least one lookup formula.

instructions.title: Submit
instructions.description: Submit a link to your spreadsheet (Google Sheets/GitHub) along with brief notes on what you changed.

rubricCriteria.name: Data Quality
rubricCriteria.description: Duplicates removed and missing values handled appropriately.

rubricCriteria.name: Formula Usage
rubricCriteria.description: At least one lookup formula and SUM/AVERAGE used correctly.

rubricCriteria.name: Summary Clarity
rubricCriteria.description: Summary section clearly communicates key figures.

rubricCriteria.name: Documentation
rubricCriteria.description: Notes clearly explain what was changed and why.
